reading: Changing weather may cause more disruption to air travel.
Summer storms brought long delays to flights near London.
Some planes had to wait on the ground while staff managed busy skies.
Some planes might need to change their routes.
Pilots use weather information to help them avoid dangerous storms.
Airports need space and services for passengers whose planes arrive somewhere unexpected.

vocabulary.definition: a problem that interrupts normal activity
times when something happens later than planned
the ways used to travel from one place to another
people travelling in a vehicle who are not driving or flying it
